reviewers.summary: Per-case snapshots address the prior multi-case revision check, and unchanged revisions are now accepted. Concurrent focus and explicit refreshes can still overwrite a newer snapshot with an older one.

findingList.message: Serialize refreshes or compare each response against the latest stored per-case revision before committing, so an overlapping refresh cannot replace a newer snapshot with an older revision.

evidence.codePathTraced: Each refresh copies the case snapshots captured when that call began, then validates responses against that copy and writes the copy back after the loop. Focus and the explicit refresh button can start separate calls before either one finishes.
evidence.failureScenario: Two refreshes start while a case is at revision 7. One receives revision 9 and stores it; the other later receives revision 8, compares it with its captured revision 7, accepts it, and overwrites the newer snapshot. The app then marks the older snapshot current and admits commands.

reviewers.summary: Per-case revision tracking fixes the earlier multi-case comparison issue, and accepting unchanged revisions fixes the normal refresh failure. Overlapping refreshes can still validate against stale state and commit out of order, allowing a lower revision to replace the current snapshot.

findingList.message: Guard refresh commits against the latest per-case revisions so overlapping focus and explicit refreshes cannot overwrite a newer snapshot with an older one.

evidence.codePathTraced: Each refresh copies hangarCaseSnapshots from the render that started it, validates responses against that copy, then replaces the state at lines 134–135. Focus and the explicit button can start overlapping refreshes, so both can validate against the same older revisions.
evidence.failureScenario: If two refreshes start with revision 7, one receives revision 9 and commits first, then the other receives revision 8 and commits later, both pass validation against revision 7. The later commit replaces revision 9 with revision 8 and leaves commands enabled despite accepting a lower revision than the current snapshot.

reviewers.summary: The round 3 changes track snapshots per case and reject lower revisions, fixing the prior revision-order finding. Unchanged revisions remain valid, fixing the prior refresh failure; I found no concrete security vulnerability in the reviewed change.
